# FlirtGym

> FlirtGym is an iPhone app for practicing dating conversations before you have them. Users run practice chats with AI characters, and every message the user writes is scored with specific coaching. Unlike AI reply-generator apps, FlirtGym scores messages the user writes rather than writing them for the user.

Publisher: Baker Ventures LLC, Logan, Utah, USA
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/flirtgym-rizz-dating-help/id6784050951
Platform: iPhone, iOS 15.1 or later. No Android or iPad version.
Age rating: 18+
Pricing: Free to download, with a free tier that has no time limit. FlirtGym Pro is $14.99/month or $59.99/year; both plans open with a one-week free trial (Apple introductory offer, one per person per subscription group). A $6.99/week tier is submitted to Apple but not yet live.
Launched: August 2026
Last updated: 2026-09-04

## Key facts

- Category: dating skills practice, not a dating app. No feed, no matches, no other users.
- Core loop: the user writes the message, FlirtGym scores it and explains what to fix.
- Practice covers texting, dating-app exchanges, in-person scenarios and cold approach.
- AI characters disengage or end the chat when user effort drops, so practice conversations can be lost.
- Also includes generation tools (openers from a profile screenshot, replies to stalled threads) and profile/photo feedback.
